summary.one_liner: A curated, opinionated list of reading resources about the Technical Program Manager (TPM) role, covering basics, company write-ups, interview prep, and project management.
summary.what_it_does: This is an awesome-style link list with no code. It collects articles, Q&A threads, and posts about what Technical Program Managers do and how the role works. Sections are titled Basics, Advanced, Interviews, Related, Project management, and Other. Basics has general role definitions, such as how TPMs differ from project and product managers. Advanced links to company posts from places like Facebook, DoorDash, FullStory, and Lyft on TPM principles and teams. Interviews lists interview guides and prep resources, including per-company items for Google, Facebook, and Amazon. The Other section points to the related kuchin/awesome-cto list.
use_cases: Learning what a technical program manager does
Setting up or building a TPM team
Comparing TPM, project manager, and product manager roles
Onboarding a new technical program manager
Finding project management and planning process reading
notable: Curated and explicitly opinionated selection of TPM-focused reading
Includes company write-ups on TPM teams from several tech companies
Dedicated interview prep section with per-company entries
Cross-linked from the broader kuchin/awesome-cto list
caveats: Only links to external articles and videos; no tools or code
The README gives no dates, so some linked material may be out of date
README has no description of maintenance status
